as_told.title: John Alexander on the Hutchison experiments

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, tells of an inventor in California named John Hutchison, who is said to have made objects levitate, a result known as the Hutchison effect. Michels says a man named John Alexander was given the job of looking into it. If the effect were real, it would point to a way of defying gravity that officials wanted to understand.
